module seven_segdisplay (clk, reset, load, bcd, hex);

input clk, reset, load;
input [3:0] bcd;
output reg [6:0] hex;

always @(posedge clk or negedge reset)
begin
	if (~reset)
		hex <= 7'b1111111;
	else if (load)
	begin
		case (bcd)
			4'h0: hex <= 7'b1000000;
			4'h1: hex <= 7'b1111001;
			4'h2: hex <= 7'b0100100;
			4'h3: hex <= 7'b0110000;
			4'h4: hex <= 7'b0011001;
			4'h5: hex <= 7'b0010010;
			4'h6: hex <= 7'b0000010;
			4'h7: hex <= 7'b1111000;
			4'h8: hex <= 7'b0000000;
			4'h9: hex <= 7'b0010000;
			default: hex <= 7'b1111111;
		endcase
	end
end
endmodule
